verdict.rationale: The MI325X ships with a substantial vendor software ecosystem (ROCm, AMD SMI, GPU Operator, Spur scheduler), so an official MCP server is a plausible capability, but nothing in the evidence documents one. The llms.txt file and the absence of an OpenAPI spec are adjacent agent-readability signals, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
